about: What gemini-pro-latest said, blind, of each candidate (tools/sound/listen.mjs), 18 November 2026: what it heard, the nearest label, how convincing 1-10 as what it is meant to be, and what gives it away. `old` is the game's own sound where one is being replaced (null for a new sound). `takes` is every generation tried, in order, whether it was shipped or not; `bandShare` is the share of its energy in 150-4000 Hz the gate measured (.work/bands.py), after whatever tilt the processing settled on (see docs/WILD-sfx.md for which sounds needed a tilt and why the figure before it was not kept). What was done with these verdicts is docs/WILD-sfx.md.

shotSentry.meant: a sentry robot's heavy rifle firing one unsuppressed round at the listener, from ten to fifteen metres, in a concrete cavern

old.heard: A single loud gunshot is fired.
old.label: gunshot, unsuppressed

shotSentry.note: shotSentry-2.mp3 is take 1 re-cut at 4% faster speed, not a fourth generation (the brief's own allowance).

shotDrone.meant: a drone's lighter, faster gun firing one round at the listener in a concrete cavern

takes.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep

shotDrone.note: no take heard blind as a gunshot in three tries: the gate's first rule failed every time, so the game's own shotDrone stays.

explosion.meant: a single large explosion inside a concrete cavern

old.heard: A rapid series of irregular clicks resembling a Geiger counter detecting radiation.
old.label: other

explosion.note: explosion-1 (take index 1 of 0-2) was heard blind as a gunshot, not an explosion, and was left out; the two shipped takes are candidates 0 and 2.

cascadeBlast.meant: a huge demolition blast in a hall of machinery, metal tearing, a hall of centrifuges going up

old.heard: I heard a series of synthetic bleeps and bloops that sound like a retro video game.
old.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep
faults: Tonal descending pitch sounds like a retro laser
Complete lack of low-frequency explosion rumble
No metallic tearing or debris impact sounds

cascadeSpin.meant: a hall of hundreds of spinning gas centrifuges, a steady intense mechanical whir
cascadeSpin.note: a new loop; only one take is ever played. Played with G.audio.loop, not G.audio.play, so it is exempt from the bed-tonality rule by name, not by nature.

whiz.meant: a single bullet passing very close by the listener's head
whiz.note: no take was heard blind as 'bullet passing close by' (not one of the listener's fixed labels in practice); the gate allows the gunshot family for this sound too, and whiz-2 cleared it. whiz-0.mp3 and whiz-1.mp3 are whiz-2 re-cut at +4% and -4% speed, not further generations.

rotorBreak.meant: machine rotors and steel casings tearing loose and clattering to the floor
rotorBreak.note: no take heard blind as metal tearing/dragging, something heavy falling, an explosion or glass breaking (the four labels the gate allows for it) in three tries: nothing of this is in the game.
